title: Police Force
summary: Capabilities of a UK police force: neighbourhood policing, emergency response and control, investigation, custody, public protection and professional standards.
sourceDescription: Starter capability map for a UK territorial police force, kept neutral between the nations of the UK. Vocabulary drawn from public College of Policing and HMICFRS materials (consulted for scope, not copied). Draft only: written by Claude and not yet reviewed by a named person with policing experience.

sources.citation: College of Policing Authorised Professional Practice (consulted for vocabulary and scope; nothing copied)
sources.reviewedBy: Pending human review — drafted by Claude Code

sources.citation: HMICFRS police effectiveness, efficiency and legitimacy inspection framework (consulted for scope coverage; nothing copied)
sources.reviewedBy: Pending human review — drafted by Claude Code

sources.citation: UK Government Functional Standards GovS 001-016 (consulted for the shared corporate capabilities)

items.name: Finance
items.description: Planning, controlling and accounting for the organisation's money and financial risk.

items.name: Financial Planning & Budgeting
items.description: Setting medium-term financial plans and annual budgets aligned to priorities.

items.name: Financial Accounting & Reporting
items.description: Recording transactions and producing statutory accounts and management reports.

items.name: Treasury & Cash Management
items.description: Managing cash, borrowing, investments and liquidity to meet obligations.

items.name: Payments & Receivables
items.description: Paying suppliers and collecting income owed to the organisation.

items.name: Financial Control & Audit Support
items.description: Maintaining internal controls and evidence for internal and external audit.

items.name: Human Resources
items.description: Attracting, developing, rewarding and retaining the people the organisation needs.

items.name: Workforce Planning
items.description: Forecasting the roles, numbers and skills the organisation will need.

items.name: Recruitment & Onboarding
items.description: Sourcing, selecting and settling new people into their roles.

items.name: Learning & Development
items.description: Building the skills, knowledge and behaviours the workforce needs.

items.name: Pay, Reward & Pensions
items.description: Administering pay, benefits and pension arrangements accurately and on time.

items.name: Employee Relations & Wellbeing
items.description: Supporting fair treatment, health, safety and engagement of employees.

items.name: Procurement
items.description: Obtaining goods, works and services that offer value for money and manage supply risk.

items.name: Category & Sourcing Strategy
items.description: Deciding how each category of spend is best sourced and competed.

items.name: Tendering & Contract Award
items.description: Running compliant competitions and awarding contracts to suppliers.

items.name: Contract & Supplier Management
items.description: Managing supplier performance, relationships and risk through the contract life.

items.name: Spend Control & Compliance
items.description: Ensuring purchases follow policy, thresholds and approved suppliers.

items.name: Information Management
items.description: Governing, protecting and exploiting the organisation's information as an asset.

items.name: Records Management
items.description: Creating, keeping and disposing of records according to retention rules.

items.name: Data Governance & Quality
items.description: Defining ownership, standards and quality controls for the organisation's data.

items.name: Information Rights & Access
items.description: Meeting freedom of information, subject access and transparency obligations.

items.name: Data Protection & Privacy
items.description: Ensuring personal data is processed lawfully, securely and proportionately.

items.name: Analytics & Business Intelligence
items.description: Turning data into insight that informs decisions and performance management.

items.name: Customer Contact
items.description: Handling enquiries, requests and feedback from the people the organisation serves.

items.name: Contact Channels
items.description: Providing phone, digital, post and face-to-face channels for contact.

items.name: Identity & Account Verification
items.description: Confirming who a customer is before acting on their behalf.

items.name: Case & Request Tracking
items.description: Recording each request and its progress until it is resolved.

items.name: Complaints & Feedback
items.description: Receiving, investigating and learning from complaints and compliments.

items.name: Accessibility & Inclusion
items.description: Making contact usable for people with different needs and languages.

items.name: Estates
items.description: Providing, operating and maintaining the buildings and land the organisation occupies.

items.name: Property Portfolio & Strategy
items.description: Deciding which properties to hold, acquire, adapt or release.

items.name: Facilities & Building Operations
items.description: Running buildings day to day: cleaning, security, utilities and reception.

items.name: Maintenance & Compliance
items.description: Keeping buildings safe, compliant and in good repair over their life.

items.name: Space & Workplace
items.description: Allocating and configuring space to how people actually work.

items.name: Energy & Sustainability
items.description: Reducing the energy, carbon and environmental impact of the estate.

items.name: Digital & Technology
items.description: Delivering and running the technology and digital services the organisation depends on.

items.name: Enterprise Architecture & Standards
items.description: Setting the target technology landscape and the standards it follows.

items.name: Application Delivery & Support
items.description: Building, buying, integrating and supporting the applications the business runs on.

items.name: Infrastructure, Cloud & Networks
items.description: Providing the compute, storage, hosting and connectivity services rely on.

items.name: Cyber Security & Resilience
items.description: Protecting systems and data from threats and recovering from disruption.

items.name: Digital Service Design
items.description: Designing user-centred digital services around real user needs.

items.name: Technology Service Management
items.description: Handling incidents, requests, changes and problems across live services.

items.name: Governance & Assurance
items.description: Directing the organisation and assuring that it is well run, lawful and accountable.

items.name: Strategy & Performance
items.description: Setting direction and measuring progress against agreed outcomes.

items.name: Risk Management
items.description: Identifying, assessing and treating the risks that threaten objectives.

items.name: Internal Audit & Assurance
items.description: Independently checking that controls work and reporting on them.

items.name: Legal & Regulatory Compliance
items.description: Meeting the laws, regulations and statutory duties that apply.

items.name: Corporate Governance
items.description: Operating the board, committees and scheme of delegation transparently.

items.name: Business Continuity & Emergency Planning
items.description: Preparing to keep essential activity going through disruption.

items.name: Neighbourhood & Community Policing
items.description: Keeping communities safe through local presence, partnerships and tackling the problems residents care about.

items.name: Community Engagement
items.description: Listening to residents and community groups and building trust in local policing.

items.name: Local Problem Solving
items.description: Working with partners to find and fix the causes of repeat local problems.

items.name: Crime Prevention
items.description: Reducing opportunities for crime through advice, design and targeted action.

items.name: Visibility & Patrol Planning
items.description: Deciding where and when officers are seen and available in each neighbourhood.

items.name: Partnership Working
items.description: Sharing information and joint action with councils, health, schools and other agencies.

items.name: Emergency Response & Control
items.description: Receiving calls for help and getting the right resources to incidents quickly.

items.name: Call Handling & Triage
items.description: Answering emergency and non-emergency contacts and judging risk and urgency.

items.name: Incident Command & Dispatch
items.description: Directing resources to incidents and keeping control of them until they are resolved.

items.name: Frontline Response
items.description: Attending incidents, protecting people and securing the scene.

items.name: Demand & Resource Management
items.description: Matching officer availability to expected demand across the force area.

items.name: Major Incident & Event Policing
items.description: Planning and running policing for large events and serious or fast-moving incidents.

items.name: Investigation & Intelligence
items.description: Establishing what happened, who is responsible and what evidence will prove it.

items.name: Crime Recording & Investigation
items.description: Recording reported crimes accurately and investigating them to a proportionate standard.

items.name: Intelligence Gathering & Analysis
items.description: Collecting, assessing and analysing information to understand threats and offenders.

items.name: Forensic & Digital Evidence
items.description: Finding, securing and examining physical and digital evidence.

items.name: Case File Preparation
items.description: Assembling evidence and statements into files ready for a charging decision.

items.name: Specialist & Covert Investigation
items.description: Carrying out authorised covert and specialist inquiries into serious offending.

items.name: Custody & Criminal Justice
items.description: Holding people lawfully and fairly, and moving cases through to a court outcome.

items.name: Custody Management
items.description: Receiving, holding and releasing detained people safely and within legal limits.

items.name: Detainee Welfare & Rights
items.description: Making sure detained people are healthy, informed and able to exercise their rights.

items.name: Charging & Prosecution Liaison
items.description: Working with prosecutors to decide charges and keep cases moving.

items.name: Courts & Witness Support
items.description: Getting officers, evidence and witnesses to court and supporting victims through the process.

items.name: Offender Management
items.description: Supervising and reducing the risk from convicted and released offenders.

items.name: Public Protection & Specialist Operations
items.description: Protecting vulnerable people and providing specialist skills that general policing cannot.

items.name: Safeguarding Vulnerable People
items.description: Identifying people at risk of harm and acting with partners to protect them.

items.name: Domestic Abuse & Sexual Offence Response
items.description: Responding to and investigating abuse, with support for victims throughout.

items.name: Roads Policing
items.description: Making roads safer by enforcing the law and responding to serious collisions.

items.name: Firearms & Armed Response
items.description: Providing trained armed officers and the command and governance behind their use.

items.name: Counter-Terrorism & Organised Crime Liaison
items.description: Working with national units to disrupt terrorism and serious organised crime.

items.name: Professional Standards & Vetting
items.description: Making sure officers and staff are trustworthy and that the public can hold the force to account.

items.name: Vetting & Clearance
items.description: Checking and re-checking the background and integrity of officers, staff and contractors.

items.name: Complaints & Conduct Handling
items.description: Receiving and resolving complaints and allegations about officer and staff behaviour.

items.name: Counter-Corruption
items.description: Detecting and acting on abuse of position and links to criminality.

items.name: Misconduct Proceedings
items.description: Running fair, timely hearings and applying outcomes where conduct falls short.

items.name: Organisational Learning
items.description: Using complaints, reviews and inspections to change policy, training and practice.

valueStreams.name: Respond to a Call
valueStreams.description: Starts when someone contacts the force for help. Ends when the incident is resolved or handed on.

valueStreams.name: Investigate a Crime
valueStreams.description: Starts when a crime is reported or discovered. Ends when the case is filed with evidence or closed with a recorded reason.

valueStreams.name: Detain to Court
valueStreams.description: Starts when a person is arrested or detained. Ends when the case is heard or the person is released.

valueStreams.name: Protect a Vulnerable Person
valueStreams.description: Starts when a risk to a vulnerable person is identified. Ends when protective actions are agreed with partners and reviewed.

valueStreams.name: Keep a Neighbourhood Safe
valueStreams.description: Starts when a community concern or local priority is identified. Ends when the problem is resolved and the community is told.
